title: someone follows a person, Page or venue, and nothing else changes

criteria.text: Following a person, Page or venue writes one row plus its event row in one transaction
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-06] person: member_follows + member.followed in withTransaction (actions/member/follow.ts); Page: group_memberships + group.member_joined (actions/group/follow.ts, #104 merged 2026-09-15, no Reviewed by, before deploy-health runs began); venue: member_saved_searches + member.saved_search.created in withTransaction (saved-search-create.ts). #966 changed only the reader, not the writes (reread 2026-10-23). unmarked: group/follow.test.ts ('writes an event', mock only); the person and venue tests only read the source text. Ticket #606 #1172 renamed the button and the lists "Get updates" and kept the same handlers, rows and events (`src/actions/group/follow.ts` and `src/actions/member/follow.ts` unchanged since 2026-10-22) [V]. Smoked: unknown. No screen shows a follow's rows; the Follow button became "Get updates" in #1172 (2026-11-02) and no run has reached a signed-in screen since (11-02 red, 11-03 and 11-05 stalled at sign-in, fix #1190 merged 11-06) [V].

criteria.text: A follow of a person, venue, or a listed or unlisted Page grants no membership, role or unlisted read, checked against every authorization/roster path
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-06] follower rows are role='member', source='soft_via_follow', relationship='follower'; manager checks key on role; owner and steward rows are untouched by follow and unfollow (#268). Partial proofs only: group/follow.test.ts ('grants no role beyond the plain one'), tests/follower-privacy-db.test.ts, tests/page-owner-follow-db.test.ts. No standing guard walks every roster and authorization path, ticket #607

[V reread 2026-11-06] group.follow on a private Page writes relationship='member', source='explicit' at once (follow.ts, reread 2026-10-23): the follower becomes a member and reads the Page. That follows F067 and the 2026-09-15 ruling ('private means membership, not following') and contradicts this criterion's 'never grants membership … or read access to anything unlisted'; the 2026-09-29 ruling adds that the two relationships no longer carry identical rights. No newer ruling in F065 since 2026-10-16. Two live rulings disagree on one surface: routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: A Member who follows a business and owns no shop still sees the offer to start something
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-06] there is no Sell control any more (/you/sell retired to Create, Don 2026-10-05, #336): since #1095 (2026-11-01) the ➕ in the header row opens a sheet whose first choice is "Start a Page" for every signed-in member (`create-targets.ts`), and /you shows "Start something" in the Your Pages header with no look at follows (#379, review-skipped; deploy-health green on 9ff415f and every later /you merge). SellCta and hasActiveBusinessGroup, which #604 is about, reach no routed surface (only `HomeFeed`, which no route renders), so #604 is stale and the criterion text still names the Sell control. Smoked: unknown. The last green run covering `you` is `smoke-live` 2026-11-01 (3df9260); #1172 (2026-11-02) changed `/you` after it (Saved row, "Getting updates"), and no run has reached a signed-in screen since (11-02 red, 11-03 and 11-05 stalled at sign-in, fix #1190 merged 11-06) [V]. No smoke account is follower-only. No test with a follower-only member.

criteria.text: Unfollow then re-follow revives the original row
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-06] person: on conflict unfollowed_at = null; Page: on conflict left_at = null, role kept (follow.ts); venue: saved-search-restore clears removed_at. Page half merged in #104 (no Reviewed by; before deploy-health runs). #966 adds Unfollow with Undo on /you/following, which re-follows through the same handler. unmarked: group/follow.test.ts ('is idempotent', mock), FollowedPagesList.test.tsx ('unfollows with Undo', mock); the person and venue tests only read the source text. Ticket #606 Smoked: unknown.
